label: s1_sub_005_woman_02
text: What an utterly dull place! Not a thing worth\nseeing![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_01
text: It’s just what I wanted! Thank you, Billy![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_02
text: Wonderful! Nothing brings me more joy than\nmaking you happy, dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_03
text: Perhaps I should buy up all this land and start\nsome kind of business here...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_04
text: Oh? Why, if it isn’t our dear commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_03
text: Your eyes do not deceive you—that is indeed our\ndear commoner![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_04
text: You really have a way of drawing people to you\nwith your charming personality, dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_05
text: Oooohohoho! I won’t say you’re wrong![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_06
text: It’s our duty as Glitterati to make the dreams of\nthe common folk a reality.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_07
text: Or more specifically, to give them fine items.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_08
text: Now, do pay attention, dear commoner. You\nwould do well to search for riches in areas where\r\nthere appears to be nothing of value at all...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_09
text: Possibilities are as vast as the ocean, no matter\nwhere you go.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_05
text: S-striking! Your words are as pickaxe to rock,\nloosing nuggets of wisdom from common stone![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_woman_10
text: Come now, Billy! I have a major craving for [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]fruit[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nonly the land of Kitakami can provide.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_06
text: Pfwee! No sooner did we depart than we shall\nreturn! You really are an exemplary Glitterati,\r\nmy dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_man_07
text: Those Kitakami apples make the best apple juice,\nyou know—I’ll whip some up for you![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_005_secretary_01
text: Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare are somewhere near\nthe border between the South Province’s Area\r\nFive and Area One.
